newsitem.title: JAPAN: MOF's Kuroda to speak at Forex Club meeting on Wed.
newsitem.headline: MOF's Kuroda to speak at Forex Club meeting on Wed.

text.p: Haruhiko Kuroda, the recently appointed director-general of the Ministry of Finance's International Finance Bureau, plans to speak at a regular summer meeting at the Forex Club on Wednesday, traders said.
Kuroda will speak at the beginning of the meeting, which is scheduled to start around 6.30 p.m. (0930 GMT) on Wednesday, they said.
Traders have been eager to hear comments on currencies from Kuroda, who in July succeeded Eisuke Sakakibara, the outspoken official dubbed "Mr Yen" for his influence over currency markets.
Kuroda, an expert on tax and budget matters, was formerly the president of the ministry's Institute of Fiscal and Monetary Policy.
The meeting will be closed to the press.
Sakakibara was appointed vice finance minister for international affairs on July 15.
